name: Flood-sensitive band (DEM-derived)
note: Cells within 1.5 km of a channel with >= 100 km2 upstream area and less than 3 m above the nearest channel bed (HAND), from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 at 60 m, simplified to 30 m. Smaller washes (upstream area < 100 km2) are not mapped here or in channels_dem.geojson: read the DEM for them. Terrain-derived, not a surveyed flood map.
